But the prosecution is bringing criminal charge. The threshold for criminal liability for "故意毁坏财物罪" is: if the value is relatively large, or causes serious consequences. Here 3166 yuan qualifies as "数额较大". So criminal charge: "故意毁坏财物罪". Also possibly "聚众扰乱公共场所秩序罪"? No.
